description: Serves one MCP server hosted on Sokie at this name. A TXT record at _sokie proves the name is the owner's, and a CNAME sends it to Sokie's edge. Applied with host set to the name, never at the apex.
variableDescription: %token%: the server domain's verification code, 12 hex characters. %target%: Sokie's edge hostname, like edge.sokie.site.
